about: Band-pass Q of the Analog Rytm MKII's analog filter against the resonance word the filter routine sends (frame +74 + 2v), measured on a unit (Nathaniel Pavel's MKII, OS 1.74) with the private Filter Probe: white noise into the BD voice, the BD voice's USB channel recorded, each step fitted with a 2-pole band-pass. Words 0x2000 down to 0xe000 in 0x0400 steps: the P2 run (23 Nov 2026, image IFC1), the mean of 880 Hz and 440 Hz. Words above 0x2000: the P1 run (22 Nov 2026), the mean at 220 Hz, 880 Hz and 3.5 kHz. Stock's RES knob sends value x 256 (0x0000..0x7f00); words below 0 (0x8000..0xffff) are signed and widen the band-pass. gain_db: the fitted band-pass's peak level against the open filter (LP2 at FRQ 127), the same runs (words above 0x2000 from P1's 880 Hz run).
